cases.title: A literal "undefined" event description is found
cases.evidence: events/zin_glo.txt:189 has desc = undefined, and no language defines a key named undefined.

cases.title: Files shipped empty to blank a vanilla file raise no header problem
cases.evidence: 84 Kaiserreich files, such as localisation/english/Juno_bop_l_english.yml, hold only a byte order mark (3 bytes) to blank the vanilla file of that name.

cases.title: Modifiers built from sub-units, categories and buildings are not reported as unknown
cases.evidence: Kaiserreich uses modifier_army_sub_unit_category_mobile_infantry_attack_factor and state_production_speed_infrastructure_factor, which the game builds from its unit categories and buildings.

cases.title: An idea picture no .gfx file defines is found
cases.evidence: common/ideas/PLS_ideas.txt:435 PLS_developing_weapons uses picture = generic_ammo; no loaded .gfx defines GFX_idea_generic_ammo (Old World Blues defines only GFX_goal_generic_ammo_box).

cases.title: Hooks of a game file the mod replaces still count as hooks the game runs
cases.evidence: Kaiserreich replaces common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt and adds to on_add_history, which the replaced vanilla file uses (00_on_actions.txt:5837) and hoi4.exe contains.

cases.title: Old World Blues organizations report no problem players would see
cases.evidence: The only findings are names its example organizations in mio.txt leave out (custom_2 and on), which are information.

cases.title: The template grid follows the mod's MAX_DIVISION_ defines
cases.evidence: Old World Blues common/defines/01_defines.lua:445-449 sets the support grid to 5 columns of 1 row, so history/units/ACH_alamo_defenders.txt:16-19 places support companies at x = 1 to 4, y = 0 correctly.

cases.title: A regiment below the mod's three-row grid is reported
cases.evidence: Old World Blues sets MAX_DIVISION_BRIGADE_HEIGHT = 3 (common/defines/01_defines.lua:446), and history/units/LAC_bigcohort.txt:9 places infantry at y = 3.

expect.includes: `infantry` sits at x = 0, y = 3, outside the regiments grid (x 0 to 4, y 0 to 2, from the `MAX_DIVISION_` defines)

cases.title: Kaiserreich variants name only equipment, modules and upgrades that load
cases.evidence: Hand-checked sweep (2026-11-06) of the 1415 create_equipment_variant blocks of Kaiserreich 1.7.

cases.title: A PNG file named .dds is read by its content, as the game reads it
cases.evidence: Kaiserreich gfx/loadingscreens/kr_sack_of_darulaman.dds is a PNG file; GFX_frontend_bg in interface/frontendmainviewbg.gfx:2 uses it and the game shows it.

cases.title: Small flags one pixel wider than the game draws are information
cases.evidence: Hand-checked sweep (2026-11-06): all 984 small flags of Kaiserreich 1.7 are 11x7 against the game's 10x7, and they look right in game.

cases.title: A sprite whose texture path is wrong is reported
cases.evidence: Old World Blues interface/TON_events.gfx:2 names gfx/interface/event_pictures/farming_tutorial.dds, but the file is at gfx/event_pictures/farming_tutorial.dds.
